unavailable: When the analytics store can't answer yet.
nothing: When no recorded page or dataset was read in this chat.
did.page: Each did.*: a short badge beside a page or dataset, what the chat's turns did with it. Read: they read the page.
did.search: It came up in a page search.
did.context: It was the page open beside the chat.
did.recall: They recalled earlier parts of the chat.
turns: Beside a page or dataset: how many turns (answers from a socio) read it; {{when}} the last time, a date and time.
recalls: How many earlier parts of this chat the socio looked back at.
more: When the list is cut short.
removed-page: In place of the title of a page that was deleted.
removed-dataset: In place of the name of a dataset that was deleted.
kinds.page: Each kinds.*: tooltip on the badge, the kind of reference. Page reads: pages a socio read.
kinds.search: Pages that came up in a socio's page search.
kinds.context: The page open beside the chat while the socio answered.
kinds.recall: A socio looking back at earlier parts of the same chat.
